# Simulering av "confounder"

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

n <- 1000
economy <- rnorm(n)

physical_activity <- economy + rnorm(n)
blood_pressure <- -economy + rnorm(n)


dat <- data.frame(economy, physical_activity, 
                  blood_pressure)



dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = physical_activity, 
             y = blood_pressure)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")



# Statistisk kontroll for økonomi

m0 <- lm(blood_pressure ~ physical_activity, 
         data = dat)


m1 <- lm(blood_pressure ~ physical_activity + 
           economy, 
         data = dat)


summary(m0)

summary(m1)


# En del av effekten skylles konfunderende variabel

n <- 1000
economy <- rnorm(n)

physical_activity <- economy + rnorm(n)
blood_pressure <- -economy -physical_activity +  rnorm(n)


dat <- data.frame(economy, physical_activity, 
                  blood_pressure)



dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = physical_activity, 
             y = blood_pressure)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")



# Statistisk kontroll for økonomi

m0 <- lm(blood_pressure ~ physical_activity, 
         data = dat)


m1 <- lm(blood_pressure ~ physical_activity + 
           economy, 
         data = dat)


summary(m0)

summary(m1)



```

## Collider bias - Seleksjonsbias

```{r}

n <- 1000

VO2max <- rnorm(n)
economy <- rnorm(n)


dat <- data.frame(VO2max, economy) |> 
  mutate(performance = VO2max + economy, 
         selected = if_else(performance > 2.5, 
                            "selected",
                            "not_selected")) |> 
  print()





dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(VO2max, economy, 
             color = selected)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  geom_smooth(aes(color = NULL), 
              method = "lm")








```
